fly_ash_300km_radius.citation: MoEFCC Fly Ash Notification, 2009 (as amended 2016 & 2021) - Rule 3: mandatory utilisation of fly ash within a 300 km radius of the thermal power station for construction and ash-based products.

hazardous_waste_license_required.citation: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016 - receiving facility must hold a valid CPCB/SPCB hazardous-waste handling authorisation (co-processing or TSDF).

perishable_storage_window.citation: Internal food-safety/perishability constraint (not a statutory rule) - spent grain and dairy effluent ferment/spoil rapidly, forcing tight delivery windows.
